CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-structure-alias, at head 145bfe197b9e7c09eb90bedadec44c6bc19d679d. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 145bfe197b9e7c09eb90bedadec44c6bc19d679d for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-structure-alias, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-structure-alias <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-structure-alias; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
seam_cut_total in tests/structure.py counts cross-seam attribute-reference occurrences, so a local alias pays (O19, planted as `prices = self._prices`, -2) and a bare getter that returns a tuple of state reads pays (rule 14, planted as `_cop_state()`, -2). Count distinct (seam, attribute) pairs reached, including through a callee, or refuse a callee whose only body is a tuple of state reads. A failing test first: plant the alias and the getter on a clean tree; neither may move the figure, and that plant is also the null control. Use the finder's harness, the plants plant_p2.diff and plant_p3.diff in the ev/ directory of probe/rev-2620-654004be. Any budget re-record the metric change forces goes in the commit message, per CLAUDE.md rule 2, and a raise needs the owner's confirmation before the branch is pushed. Follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md.
